articles.title: Does Compass Therapeutics' (CMPX) Biliary Cancer Data Hint At A Broader Pipeline Re‑Rating Opportunity?
articles.mainIdea: Does Compass Therapeutics' (CMPX) Biliary Cancer Data Hint At A Broader Pipeline Re‑Rating Opportunity?
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Does Compass Therapeutics' (CMPX) Biliary Cancer Data Hint At A Broader Pipeline Re‑Rating Opportunity?. Compass Therapeutics recently reported that its Phase 2/3 COMPANION-002 trial in previously treated advanced biliary tract cancer met the primary endpoint, with tovecimig plus paclitaxel achieving higher response rates and longer median progression-free survival than paclitaxel alone, while maintaining a safety profile consistent with earlier studies.
